_note: Mind skills (one lesson a week, by week number), the pre-stage routine menu Sofia builds from, and the comp-day fuel plan. Sofia is vegetarian + fish (pescatarian). Kid-facing lines: short, verbs first. Nothing here is medical advice.

lessons.why: A slow breath out tells your body it's safe. Nerves drop, legs come back.
steps: Breathe in for 4.
Breathe out for 6, like fogging a mirror.
Three times. Shoulders down on the last one.
lessons.try: Do three long breaths out before every run this week.

lessons.why: Eyes that wander look scared. Eyes that pick a spot look like a performer.
steps: Pick one spot above the back row.
Every time your face turns front, find it.
Name it: 'the exit sign', 'the clock'.
lessons.try: Say your focal point out loud before the music starts.

lessons.why: Everyone slips. Judges only remember a slip if your face tells them.
steps: Finish the shape you're in, even if it's wrong.
Breathe out.
Next count, you're back. No face.
lessons.try: In practice, make one mistake on purpose and reset without a face.

lessons.why: When you think about the story, you stop thinking about the steps.
steps: Say the story in one sentence.
Pick who you're dancing to.
Decide what you want from them.
lessons.try: Before a run, whisper the story once.

lessons.why: Five fixes at once = none fixed. One fix = done by Friday.
steps: Read this week's fix.
Say it in five words or less.
That's the only note today.
lessons.try: Say your one thing before practice. Only that one.

lessons.why: Butterflies and excitement feel the same inside. You get to pick the name.
steps: Feel the butterflies.
Say: 'I'm excited.'
Smile. Your body believes your face.
lessons.try: Next time your tummy flips, say 'I'm excited' out loud.

lessons.why: Dancers who picture the dance before they dance it make fewer mistakes.
steps: Close your eyes.
Watch yourself do the first 8 counts, perfectly.
Open your eyes and do them.
lessons.try: Picture the ending pose before every run.

lessons.why: Tight muscles make small dancing. Shaking tells them to let go.
steps: Shake hands for 5 seconds.
Shake each leg.
Roll shoulders back twice. Big breath.
lessons.try: Shake out before the warm-up every day.

lessons.why: What you notice grows. Notice the good thing and it gets bigger.
steps: After practice, say one thing you did well.
It has to be true.
Say it to a grown-up.
lessons.try: Tell someone your one true thing tonight.

lessons.why: Rushing makes mistakes. Clean and slow becomes clean and fast.
steps: Do the hard part at half speed.
Make it perfect twice.
Then speed up a little.
lessons.try: Run the trick section at 75% before 100% this week.

ritual.say: One sentence. Who is it for?
Above the back row. That's where your eyes live.
Small, with the arms. Feel the start.
Tall. Chest open. Hands on hips.
Say your three words. Out loud.

compFuel.eat: Pasta or rice with veggies and beans, tofu or fish. Water. Bed early.
Oats or toast with peanut butter and banana, or eggs with toast. A glass of milk or juice.
Small snack: banana, crackers with cheese, or a granola bar. Sips of water.
Sips of water. Fruit, pretzels or a few crackers. Nothing heavy, nothing new.
Within an hour: a sandwich (egg, cheese, tuna or hummus), yogurt and fruit, or a smoothie.
Water bottle always in reach. Pack snacks she's eaten before.
